posthoc_discordant_failure.rule: First DVAC failure in original manifest planned order whose matched fixed_10 episode succeeds; inspect both videos.
posthoc_discordant_failure.interpretation_limit: Outcome-selected diagnostic example, not a representative error-rate estimate or evidence of causality. The prespecified demo is unchanged.

instructions: Enter only visually supported observations, link episode/frame references, and keep interpretations distinct from observed facts. Leave uncertain causes unresolved. A closing command does not establish a successful grasp.
